subject: MedVantage MAP: POC kickoff & target cutover dates
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@medvantage.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedVantage MAP: POC kickoff & target cutover dates

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call today. As promised, I’m putting the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) items for the POC environment here so we can lock in dates and owners. The primary technical path for the POC is hosted API usage with one VPC peering test to validate throughput to your ingestion service. Key items below: 

- Org + tenant creation: MedVantage will get an initial org seeded by Redwood (org id: MV-trial-01). We need confirmation of the list of users who should be admins.
- API keys: Redwood will create a scoped API key for the POC (read/write for trial tenant). We’ll hand off via encrypted transfer.
- IP allowlist: Temporary allowlist for test harness (single public egress range) + persistent allowlist for peering acceptance.
- VPC peering: Pilot peering between a single subnet in your staging VPC and our POC VPC (no cross-prod traffic).

Proposed timeline (one-week pilot):
- Sep 20: Org created + API key issued
- Sep 21: IP allowlist applied; test harness smoke run
- Sep 22: VPC peering establish and validation (limited to CIDR x.x.x.x/28)
- Sep 24: Performance sanity checks + handoff to MedVantage devops

Attachments: MedVantage_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook with action owners, timeline).

As next steps, can you confirm: (1) who should be org admins, (2) a preferred maintenance window for peering (UTC window), and (3) the external address range we should allow for the test harness? I’ll loop in Neha for the network specifics and Naomi for the onboarding doc and billing sync.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@medvantage.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: devops@medvantage.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedVantage MAP: POC kickoff & target cutover dates

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear layout. This looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A couple of quick clarifications before I confirm owners: 

1) Maintenance window: We prefer peering work during 00:00–04:00 UTC to avoid daytime traffic. Is that workable on your side?
2) CIDR constraints: We’ll need to limit the peered subnet to a /28 for now. Can you confirm Redwood’s endpoint IP (or the range) so we can start internal approvals?
3) Procurement: I’m looping Tom Keller (procurement) separately for the MSAs; he’ll want to see the MAP workbook and the draft SOW.

Putting devops@medvantage.com on this thread to coordinate the staging-ns.

We’ll aim to have org admin list to you by EOD Monday Sep 21 if that fits your timeline.

—Sara
VP Product, MedVantage

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@medvantage.com>, devops@medvantage.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 12:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedVantage MAP: POC kickoff & target cutover dates

Sara / Devops team —

Following up with the technical constraints and a recommended sequence so your networking folks have what they need to start internal approvals: 

Required items we need from MedVantage:
- Target staging VPC CIDR (example: 10.41.0.0/16) and the single /28 for peering acceptance (please confirm exact /28).
- Public egress IP(s) that the test harness will use for the temporary allowlist.
- A contact for BGP/peering ops (if you run managed peering).

Redwood notes/requirements:
- We’ll request a /28 in your staging scope; we will not create routing to prod subnets.
- Ephemeral API keys: for the POC we issue a time-limited key that expires after 14 days; if you need longer, we can do a scoped token rotation plan.
- Firewall rules: Please allow outbound HTTPS (443) to our ingestion endpoint range 35.214.72.0/27 (for POC validation).

Sequence I recommend for minimum risk:
1) We create the org and issue API key (Rishi)
2) You add temporary allowlist for our test harness IP (you keep control)
3) Smoke tests without peering (validate token + basic API calls)
4) Once smoke is green, schedule VPC peering during your 00:00–04:00 UTC window for power-users validation

I’ve attached a simple diagram for the peering step: network-diagram-vpc-peering.png.

If Tom’s procurement needs a technical appendix, I can draft a short ops note (1 page) that calls out data flow, logs, and retention.

-Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: devops@medvantage.com
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@medvantage.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@medvantage.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedVantage MAP: POC kickoff & target cutover dates

Hi all —

We can do the 00:00–04:00 UTC window on Sep 22 for the peering. A few constraints from our side: 

- We cannot accept a /28 that overlaps any existing cross-account peering ranges — we’ll validate and send back the exact /28 to accept. Expect that by EOD Sep 20.
- For the temporary allowlist, we’ll open 35.214.72.45/32 for the smoke run; please confirm that is one of your endpoints.
- Security questionnaire: we require the AUP + SOC2 scoping doc before we start peering. Sharing the link to our vendor questionnaire: https://medvantage.sharepoint.com/sites/security/vendor-questionnaire (we’ve prefilled a couple of fields).

Also, procurement (Tom) asks for a short SOW appendix that references the MAP workbook and the acceptance criteria (pass/fail for the POC). Tom — I’ll leave it to you and Rishi to coordinate on the SOW and signature flow.

Thanks,
MedVantage DevOps
devops@medvantage.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedVantage MAP: POC kickoff & target cutover dates

Great — thanks everyone for the quick alignment. Finalizing owners and next steps below and attaching the updated MAP workbook and short SOW appendix (medvantage-provisioning-checklist.pdf).

Action items and owners:
- Rishi: Send MSA + AUP to Tom for signature (DocuSign link included). Target: Sep 21 EOD for signature initiation.
- Tom: Procurement review + return countersigned MSA (if any redlines are needed, please flag by Sep 23).
- MedVantage DevOps: Confirm exact /28 by EOD Sep 20 and open 35.214.72.45/32 for initial smoke run on Sep 21.
- Neha: Prepare 1-page ops appendix for procurement and the network diagram (done).
- Naomi: Onboarding doc + billing contact — Naomi will send trial billing contact form by Sep 20.

We will hold the peering window on Sep 22 00:00–04:00 UTC; if the /28 confirmation slips, we’ll revert to smoke-only on Sep 21 and reschedule peering.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1283745/MV-2026-091 (I’ve updated the MAP workbook with these owners).

Attachments: MedVantage_MAP_v1.xlsx, medvantage-provisioning-checklist.pdf.

If everyone confirms, I’ll initiate the DocuSign envelope and share the link here.

Best,
